source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Siddhant Bhoite's 7-Sep batch, 8 cards: Apollo SBI SELECT, BOBCARD Premier, IRCTC SBI Premier, Kotak Zen Signature, SBI MILES, SBI PULSE, YES Wellness Plus and YES Prosperity Cashback Plus. 176 exclusion rows added and 1 removed, 3 milestones, 24 field corrections, and his highlights and pros/cons on all 8. NOT ONE reward_rule was added, deleted, renamed or re-rated - total_reward_rules is unchanged and every rule_name is byte-identical, because the app keys each user's cap progress on that string. Two of the eight (Apollo, YES Wellness Plus) had ZERO exclusion rows before this. All 3 milestones carry bonus_value null, because each pays a lounge VISIT and wallet_insights_service.dart:118 renders bonus_value as 'unlocks Rs.<n>' in a push notification. Every proposed exclusion was walked against its own card's reward rules and against merchants.json before being written; the ones that would have silenced a card's own benefit were refused, including MCC 4900/utilities on YES Prosperity (the card pays 0.75% on six utility merchants) and MCCs 5964/5969 on the same card, which sit in Amazon's and Flipkart's own mcc_codes. Also corrected: SBI PULSE redemption fee Rs.100 -> Rs.99 on two channels, and YES Wellness Plus loses its 'Club Vistara Points' transfer row and renames 'InterMiles' to 'Air India Maharaja Club' - Vistara merged into Air India and the programme no longer exists. redemption_rules IS read by the app (credit_card.dart:952) and feeds the Redemption tab, so both of those are user-visible; tools/app_mirror/app_json_keys.json is stale in saying otherwise.
